description: Upload a logo, a label or a photo and get a die-cut sticker PNG: cut out, with an even white border and a transparent background, ready to print. With a redeem code that has credits it spends one credit and returns the clean PNG's URL. Without a code it returns a free watermarked preview URL and an unlock object that says how your user can pay.

code.description: The redeem code your user got after paying on the site. Optional when the MCP connection already sends it as Authorization: Bearer.

image_url.description: An https URL of an existing design (PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 24 MB). Its background is removed and its edge cleaned; nothing is redrawn.

preset.description: The style. Defaults to the first.

prompt.description: What the image shows, 3 to 400 characters. One subject works best. No real people. Give this OR image_url.

name: generate
title: Make a sticker
